mode: Built-in image_gen, edits of supplied real product photos

prompts.01-clean-product:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: polished real-photo matcha latte catalogue image, portrait 3:4.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the customer's actual 128am Cafe matcha latte photograph. Retouch this exact photo into a clean commercial product photograph, not an illustration.
Keep the actual cup shape and proportions, clear sip lid, white crimped sealing paper directly under the lid, natural condensation, dark green matcha fading into pale milk, and the existing transparent girl and two-eared rabbit logo. Preserve the existing label lettering 128am CAFE and mascot faithfully. Do not redesign or enlarge the sticker.
Improve exposure and white balance so the drink looks fresh and appetizing, but retain realistic deep matcha green and natural milk tones. Replace the cool grey wall and tabletop with a seamless very pale warm cream studio background, approximately #FFF8F5, with a soft real contact shadow. Centre the complete cup in a 3:4 portrait crop with about 70 percent of the image height occupied by the cup and generous uncluttered margins. Entire lid and cup base visible. Sharp product edges, real plastic reflections, natural photographic surface texture. No new props, no straw, no extra ingredients, no graphic text, no border, no watermarks. Opaque background. This is an edit of the real photograph, not a substitute imaginary product.
